hero.title: Document Apostille for International Use
hero.subtitle: Get guidance to prepare and apostille your documents for use abroad.

about.title: What is the Hague Apostille?
about.description: The Hague Apostille is a certificate that authenticates the origin of certain public documents so that they can be used in another country that is a party to the Hague Convention.
about.additionalInfo: In immigration, study, marriage, document recognition, and other international proceedings, certain documents may need to be apostilled before being submitted to the authorities of the destination country.

important.title: Important
important.text: The apostille certifies the authenticity of the signature, seal, or stamp appearing on the document. It does not certidy the content of the document or replace a translation when one is required.
